item.title: Introducing LGBT stories linked to more inclusive attitudes in primary schools
item.description: Can literature foster greater acceptance of LGBT people among elementary school students? This is the core question behind a study conducted by researchers Guillermo Soler, María Ribes and José Rovira-Collado from the Language and Literature Didactics area of the Department of Teaching Innovation and Training at the University of Alicante (UA). Fuente: Phys.org.
